name: Octavia Thuss
office: La Cañada Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Octavia Thuss is a member of the La Cañada Unified School District Governing Board, serving as clerk. She says she has more than 30 years of experience in K-12 public education as a teacher, substitute, and volunteer, and holds a master’s degree in education.

sentences.text: Octavia Thuss is a member of the La Cañada Unified School District Governing Board, serving as clerk.
She says she has more than 30 years of experience in K-12 public education as a teacher, substitute, and volunteer, and holds a master’s degree in education.

items.text: At an October 2026 candidate forum, she listed her priorities as fiscal responsibility, hiring teachers, ensuring safety, and providing academic and extracurricular opportunities. Her campaign site calls for improving school safety including wildfire preparedness, supporting mental health, implementing expanded-day kindergarten, and aligning budget allocations with district priorities. She says she wants to provide leadership to oversee bond projects and the district's transition to a new superintendent.
